recentItems.title: Hargrove, arr. Mike Kamuf – Score & Sound
recentItems.description:
For more information, or to purchase, go to https://bit.ly/4fesD9U.
 
Hargrove
By Rodney Jordan, arr. Mike Kamuf
00-50464
Premier Jazz Series
Grade: 4
In the style of the late, great Roy Hargrove, this straight-eighth funky chart soars. It’s played around 100 BPM and the lead trumpet range is to written D above the staff. A burnin’ sax soli is followed by a power-house shout chorus with optional flute and vibes. This is a winner!

recentItems.description:

Spring is Here
Words by Lorenz Hart, Music by Richard Roger, arr. Scott Ragsdale
00-50469
Jazz Vocal Series
Grade: 3
Simply a gorgeous vocal w/big band chart. This straight-eighth ballad is played around 74-78 BPM. The vocal range is from G below middle C to third space C and lead trumpet range is to written A above the staff. The ballad transitions midway to a bossa with a slightly quicker feel then returns to the sweet ballad. Exquisite vocal chart.

Mambo over the Mountain
By Rick Hirsch
00-50459
Young Jazz Series
Grade: 2.5
Here’s an exciting mambo, a very cool arrangement indeed! Played with half note=88-108 BPM. Highlights include alto and trombone solos, a sax section soli, and an aux percussion part for congas. This is a well-constructed, fun to play yet accessible chart.
